prompt_text: Best donor CRM for food security organizations
response_text:
### Top Donor CRM Recommendations for Food Security Organizations

Food security organizations (e.g., food banks, hunger relief nonprofits) need CRMs that excel in donor management, fundraising campaigns, event tracking, and integration with tools for tracking distributions or volunteer coordination. Based on 2026 analyses from specialized nonprofit resources, here are the strongest options tailored to this sector. I prioritized tools with proven use by hunger relief groups, ease for small-to-mid-sized orgs, and features like donation pages, reporting, and supporter segmentation.

#### 1. **Givebutter** (Top Overall Pick for Fundraising-Focused Food Security Orgs)
   - **Why it fits**: Modern, all-in-one platform combining CRM, donor database, engagement tracking, personalized emails, and high-conversion donation pages. Ideal for food banks running peer-to-peer campaigns or recurring drives.
   - **Key features**: Unlimited contacts, built-in forms/events/ticketing, mobile app, free tier available.
   - **Pricing**: Free core features; premium starts ~$19/mo.
   - **Evidence**: Ranked #1 in [Double the Donation's 2026 top nonprofit CRMs](https://doublethedonation.com/top-nonprofit-crms/), praised for supporter management and fundraising.

#### 2. **GoFundMe Pro (formerly Classy)** (Best for High-Volume Donation Pages)
   - **Why it fits**: Trusted by major hunger relief orgs (e.g., Feeding America affiliates). Optimized for polished, mobile-first donation experiences while consolidating donor data for CRM insights.
   - **Key features**: Custom campaign pages, A/B testing, supporter segmentation, integrations with payment processors.
   - **Pricing**: Custom quotes; starts ~$100/mo for basics.
   - **Evidence**: Highlighted in [Humanitru's guide to CRMs for food banks](https://www.humanitru.com/blog/the-best-crms-data-and-fundraising-tools-for-food-banks) as a go-to for large-scale relief efforts.

#### 3. **Bloomerang** (Best for Donor Retention and Small Food Security Nonprofits)
   - **Why it fits**: Excels at relationship-building with donor profiles, engagement scoring, and retention tools—crucial for repeat food drive supporters. Simple for resource-strapped teams.
   - **Key features**: Wealth screening, automated communications, reporting dashboards, volunteer tracking.
   - **Pricing**: ~$119/mo (unlimited users).
   - **Evidence**: Featured in [Kindsight's 14 best nonprofit CRMs](https://kindsight.io/resources/blog/best-crm-for-nonprofits/), [Bloomerang's own 2026 roundup](https://bloomerang.com/blog/nonprofit-crm/), and [LiveImpact's small nonprofit comparison](https://www.liveimpact.org/blog/best-crm-for-small-nonprofit) as a retention leader.

#### 4. **DonorPerfect** (Best for Comprehensive Data Management)
   - **Why it fits**: Robust cloud-based CRM with unlimited users, batch donation processing, and detailed reporting—great for tracking food program funding alongside donors.
   - **Key features**: Custom fields, pledge tracking, online forms, nonprofit discounts.
   - **Pricing**: ~$89/mo+ (with discounts).
   - **Evidence**: Recommended in [Bloomerang's 2026 guide](https://bloomerang.com/blog/nonprofit-crm/), [TechSoup forums for ministries](https://forums.techsoup.org/t/searching-for-a-good-donor-crm-for-years-that-fit-our-ministries-needs/7478), and multiple top lists.

#### Quick Comparison Table

| CRM            | Best For                  | Starting Price | Free Tier? | Food Bank/Hunger Proof |
|----------------|---------------------------|----------------|------------|------------------------|
| **Givebutter** | Fundraising + Engagement  | Free/$19/mo   | Yes       | Top-ranked 2026 lists |
| **GoFundMe Pro** | Donation Optimization   | ~$100/mo      | No        | Used by major relief orgs |
| **Bloomerang** | Donor Retention           | ~$119/mo      | No        | Small nonprofit favorite |
| **DonorPerfect** | Data/Reporting Depth    | ~$89/mo       | No        | Discounts + batch tools |

#### How to Choose
- **Small orgs (<50 donors/mo)**: Start with Givebutter (free) or Bloomerang.
- **Scaling food banks**: GoFundMe Pro for campaigns; DonorPerfect for ops.
- **Next steps**: Demo via their sites, check TechSoup for discounts, and ensure integrations (e.g., with QuickBooks or Mailchimp). For food-specific needs like inventory ties, pair with tools from Humanitru's list.

These picks draw directly from 2026 nonprofit CRM rankings emphasizing real-world use by similar orgs. If your org has unique needs (e.g., size, budget), provide more details for refined advice.
